name: El Grande Big Box

rounds.endCondition: Game ends after the third general scoring (after round 9)

categories.label: General scoring 1 (after round 3)
categories.hint: Castillo (5/3/1) + each region by Caballeros majority + King's region +2 + home region +2, as moved on the score track.

categories.label: General scoring 2 (after round 6)
categories.hint: Same as scoring 1, plus any points from Special Scoring action cards played in rounds 4-6.

categories.label: General scoring 3 (after round 9)
categories.hint: Final general scoring; includes Castillo, all regions, King's and home-region bonuses.

categories.label: Special scoring and action-card points
categories.labelVi: Điểm từ thẻ Chấm điểm đặc biệt / hành động
categories.hint: Points from Special Scoring cards (5/6/7-point regions, Castillo) and other action cards played between scorings.

tiebreakers.description: No tiebreaker: players tied for most points share the victory.

notes: family: auction-money (actually area-majority on a running score track; the in-play card auction decides turn order). Region values are printed on the board scoreboards; tied players score for the next lower rank; 2 players score only 1st place, 3 players 1st and 2nd; Grandes do not count for majority; King's/home bonus +2 need a sole majority. Simplified to the score track split by scoring event; itemising each region needs the board values. Rules checked against the standard El Grande rulebook (Z-Man); the Big Box rulebook PDF (BGG file 115171) could not be downloaded, and Big Box expansions (Intrigue/King, Grande Inquisitor etc.) are not modelled.
